narratives.title: MCP servers and agent-ready prompts become the default onboarding path

narratives.title: Testing and verification for agent-written code
narratives.summary: Storybook covers component testing in an era of agent-written UI, and Expo plans cloud device testing for agents without Xcode or a Mac.

narratives.title: Claude Opus 5.5 rolls out across coding tools

narratives.title: MCP and programmatic access for agents

narratives.title: Opus 5.5 real-world evals: quality gains vs token cost
narratives.summary: CodeRabbit's review-pipeline test (51 vs 49, and 10 vs 5 on harder cases) shows better catches but ~50% more tokens, while Factory and Lovable report efficiency gains.
narratives.angle: Share a concrete take on cost per bug caught or per task, contrasting CodeRabbit's extra tokens with Factory's 20-25% fewer output tokens.

narratives.title: Databases built for agent fleets and search

narratives.angle: Offer a technical take on isolating many agent databases versus sharing one, with concrete limits on provisioning and cost.

narratives.title: Self-driving products and agents that fix bugs

narratives.title: Claude Opus 5.5 rolls out across coding tools

narratives.angle: Offer a concrete checklist for MCP write tools: draft state, versioning, rollback, and deduplicated payloads to save context.

narratives.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna launch with cost-per-task claims
narratives.summary: Devin and Lovable report GPT-6 Sol matching or beating GPT-5.6 at much lower cost, with Luna under $0.10 per task.

narratives.title: Databases and APIs built for agents

narratives.title: FrontierCode and CursorBench leaderboard shifts

narratives.title: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 land across coding tools
narratives.summary: Kiro, Factory, v0 and Replit all shipped Claude 5.5 models within hours, with Kiro citing Fable 5.1-level performance at 40% lower cost than Opus 5 and Factory sharing early behavioral observations.

narratives.title: Platforms building for AI agents as users
